messages:
maya: heads-up — vendor scheduled a short maintenance on their apac-rack-42 (H100 slab) tomorrow 2026-03-19 02:00-03:00 UTC. We have 6 interactive demos pinned to dedicated-pool-apac and a queue of 4. Can we avoid impacting customer-facing demos? looking for quick options: shift some demos to staging-pool, borrow 2 H100 from partner-rack, or postpone. @kai (oncall) any objections to pre-warming staging?

sam: I can try to shift 2 reservations to staging. We currently have 1 free H100 slot in staging but nightly-regress uses one slot. Could reschedule that, or we could use A100-80g as fallback if latency hit is OK.

joan: quick Q — how many GPUs per demo? If it's 1 each, borrowing 2 reduces queue but demos may see higher tail latency. vendor emailed it only affects rack-42 (not whole region).

maya: each interactive demo uses 1xH100, ~24GB footprint. Latency bump is acceptable for a small subset but we prefer not to change model quantization. main priority is avoid customer-facing 503s.

sam: ok i'm going to attempt to shift 2 demos now. command i'll run: `rcli pool move --from dedicated-pool-apac --to staging-pool --count 2 --tag demo`

kai (oncall): i'm oncall overlap, fine to move. if move fails, fallback is to set route=staging in demo service and throttle ingress. also @deploy-bot please open a ticket for vendor maintenance + borrow request. :+1:

deploy-bot: ticket #INF-4521 opened — "Vendor rack-42 maintenance — demo borrow request" (owner: sam, priority: p2)

joan: pinging vendor contact via @vendor-bot to confirm partner-rack spare H100 availability.

vendor-bot: vendor confirms 2 spare H100s in partner-rack are reservable for 4 hours starting 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. Reservation code: VEND-349. Note: cross-rack billing/egress applies.

maya: great — sam can you include reservation code in the move and add `vendor_res=VEND-349` to the demo metadata? also please leave a short note in the ticket.

sam: done. ran: `rcli pool move --from dedicated-pool-apac --to staging-pool --count 2 --tag demo --vendor-res VEND-349`
logs: `moved 2 demos (ids: d-443,d-444) -> staging-pool; reserved VEND-349`

joan: updating demos doc + pinging #product-demo to mention the short maintenance window and which demos were moved. :white_check_mark:

kai (oncall): i'll watch ingress errors and enable fallback routing if 5xx rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 2s during window.

maya: thanks all — closing the loop here. if anything breaks ping me directly and i'll re-route traffic.
